slides.title: 10-minute bedroom reset for when you can't face your room
Minutes 0–2: trash only
slides.body: Grab a bag. Wrappers, receipts, empty bottles. It's the fastest visible change.

slides.title: Minutes 2–4: all dishes out
slides.body: Every mug and plate to the kitchen in one trip. Don't wash them yet. Only out.

slides.title: Minutes 4–7: clothes in 2 spots
slides.body: Dirty in the hamper, clean on the bed. Don't fold or hang yet. Only 2 spots.

slides.title: Minutes 7–9: clear the nightstand
slides.body: It's the first thing you see in the morning and the last at night. A clear one feels like a reset.

slides.title: Minute 10: make the bed, badly
slides.body: Pull the covers up. Wrinkles are fine. A made bed makes the whole room look done.

slides.title: A badly made bed still counts as a made bed.
Every room in 15 minutes or less
